# snipeit_component_checkout (Resource)

Checks units of a component out to an asset. Creating the resource performs the checkout, destroying it checks the same quantity back in. All attributes force replacement.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Check component units out to an asset; destroy checks the same qty back in.
resource "snipeit_component_checkout" "ram_upgrade" {
  component_id = snipeit_component.ddr5.id
  asset_id     = snipeit_hardware.workstation.id
  qty          = 2
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `asset_id` (Number) Id of the asset receiving the component units.
- `component_id` (Number) Id of the component to check out.
- `qty` (Number) Number of units to check out.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Id of the component-asset (pivot) row, used for checkin.
